options.name: account_name
options.description: The host specified in the inventory. Represents the Solace Cloud Account. Note: Only used internally in the playbooks, so you can choose whichever name makes sense in your case.

options.name: return_format
options.description: The format of the returned JSON. Either as a JSON object or a JSON array. Note: Use 'dict' when you want to access the facts in a playbook by account_name (i.e. 'inventory_hostname') directly. Note: Use 'list' when you want to iterate over each service in your playbook.

options.name: solace_cloud_api_token
options.description: The API Token. Generate using Solace Cloud console with the appropriate permissions for the operations you want to enable.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Connection timeout in seconds for the http request or overall call interaction timeout for Solace Cloud API.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Flag to switch validation of client certificates on/off when using a secure connection.
